title: rotation-gap-fano-s1: pre-registered reproduction of the Fano-factor results (Table III, §II F) of arXiv:2604.11963 from raw Google Willow detector telemetry
description:
A pre-registered, deterministic reproduction of the Fano-factor results reported in Table III and Section II F of arXiv:2604.11963 (Stenberg, 2026), computed from the raw detector bitstreams of the Google Willow surface-code dataset (Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.13273331, MD5 21fa6ad35b395d838ebcdbc92e364a12, 5716907033 bytes).

Method. Comparison criteria, estimators and decision thresholds were frozen in a Git root commit (ff84608) before any byte of the archive was downloaded. The harness verifies the SHA-256 of the pre-registration and the MD5 of the archive, compares 1260 member digests against a committed manifest, and halts without issuing a verdict if any halting premise fails. All 420 experiments (14 subgrids x 2 bases x 15 round counts) were processed.

Verdicts under the pre-registered rules. Overall Fano factor 2.4157 +/- 0.3620 (source: 2.42 +/- 0.36) — Verified. Per code distance d=3/5/7: 2.2942 / 2.5935 / 2.7978 (source: 2.29 / 2.59 / 2.80) — Verified. One-way ANOVA across distances F = 59.1337 (source: 59.1) — Verified. One-sample t against a Poisson null F=1: t = +80.15 (source: +80) — Verified.

Scope of the claim. This establishes the arithmetic reproducibility of Table III and Section II F from raw telemetry, and nothing more. No endorsement, validity or evaluation transfers to any companion theoretical claim in the source paper. The overall Fano factor consumed 86 percent of its pre-registered tolerance (|delta| = 0.0043 against a band of 0.005); the verdict changes to Verified with Limitations on the fourth decimal.

Determinism. results.json was regenerated byte-identical across three independent downloads of the 5.7 GB archive and two separate sessions (zero-byte diffs recorded in results/determinism_diff.txt and results/determinism_vs_committed.txt).

Known defects. The pre-registered scope test over round counts had zero discriminatory power, because the archive is balanced at 28 experiments per round value; it is logged as FAILURES.md entry #001. A second process defect is logged as entry #002. Both are published rather than corrected silently.

Independence. As of this release, no party outside VolMax Studio Lab has executed reproduce.py. This is a reproduction, not an independent reproduction.

No raw data is redistributed; the archive is referenced by SHA-256 digests in data_manifest.json.
notes: Audit artefact produced under the P10 verification protocol. Ratified by human merge of pull request #1 into main. The literal status string inside PREREGISTRATION.md and results/results.json remains 'SPREMNO ZA GEJT' because those files are cryptographically pinned and deterministically regenerated respectively; ratification resides in the merge commit.
